title: A Helmet Carried Into the Extra Days of an Equipment Rental and Demo Extension
content:
A helmet taken as an extra on an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement goes on being worn through the extra days, and its day price joins the daily figure those days are charged at.

## The rule

Where the rental account carries the package's helmet add-on against the agreement, and the agreement stands with the kit out, the package's helmet day price is added to the daily figure for each extra day.

Where the rental account carries that add-on and the agreement does not stand with the kit out, half that price is added.

In any other case nothing is added under this heading.

## The package figures this rule reads

| Package | Helmet day price | Half of it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 12.00 USD | 6.00 USD |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 12.00 USD | 6.00 USD |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 14.00 USD | 7.00 USD |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 12.00 USD | 6.00 USD |

Half the price is rounded half up to two decimal places.

## The two conditions in combination

| Helmet add-on on the rental account | The agreement stands with the kit out | Added to the daily figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the package's helmet day price |
| yes | no | half the package's helmet day price |
| no | either way | nothing under this heading |

## Worked figures on a hypothetical extension

Take a Performance Ski & Board Rental agreement whose helmet day price is 14.00 USD and whose daily figure stands at 68.00 USD when this heading is reached.

- The account carries the helmet add-on and the agreement stands with the kit out: 14.00 USD joins the daily figure, giving 82.00 USD a day.
- The account carries the helmet add-on and the agreement stands with kit set aside and not yet collected: 7.00 USD joins the daily figure, giving 75.00 USD a day.
- The account carries no helmet add-on: nothing joins the daily figure under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**A helmet that is part of the package.** Where a package hands a helmet over inside it, its helmet day price is 0.00 USD, so a helmet add-on on such an agreement adds nothing a day.
